title: Stop That Pawn
reviewNotes: Three selected branches, 27 exact positions from the complete six-piece source root. Nb6+ ...Kb8 Rc3 allows promotion before Nd7+ and the b3 rook sacrifice deflect the queen into Nc5+. The ...Ka7 alternative uses Ra3+ to reach the same fork. Selected ...Kc6 Nxb3 completion leaves an exact knight-and-pawn win. Rook-first Ra7+ ...Kb8 Ra6 ...b1=Q Rb6+ ...Ka8 Rxb1 is actual stalemate.
